mapper.sql: EXCHARGE_CODE as exchargeCode, DATASOURCE_TYPE as datasourceType, TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, OPEN_PRICE as openPrice, CLOSE_PRICE as closePrice, MID_PRICE as midPrice, HIGH_PRICE as highPrice, LOW_PRICE as lowPrice, BASIS_CYY as basisCyy, QUOT_UNIT as quotUnit, INPUT_TYPE as inputType, MARKET_TYPE as marketType, DEAD_LINE as deadLine, CREATE_USER as createUser, CREATE_DEPT as createDept, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_USER as updateUser, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime
mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE CII USING (
select #{item.exchargeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} EXCHARGE_CODE, #{item.tradeDate,jdbcType=DATE} TRADE_DATE, #{item.datasourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATASOURCE_TYPE, #{item.openPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} OPEN_PRICE, #{item.closePrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} CLOSE_PRICE, #{item.highPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} HIGH_PRICE, #{item.lowPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} LOW_PRICE, #{item.midPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL} MID_PRICE, #{item.basisCyy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BASIS_CYY, #{item.quotCyy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} QUOT_CYY, #{item.quotUnit,jdbcType=DECIMAL} QUOT_UNIT, #{item.inputType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} INPUT_TYPE, #{item.marketType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} MARKET_TYPE, #{item.deadLine,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DEAD_LINE, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT from dual
) TEMP
ON (CII.EXCHARGE_CODE = TEMP.EXCHARGE_CODE AND CII.TRADE_DATE = TEMP.TRADE_DATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.DATASOURCE_TYPE = TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE, CII.BASIS_CYY = TEMP.BASIS_CYY, CII.QUOT_CYY = TEMP.QUOT_CYY, CII.QUOT_UNIT = TEMP.QUOT_UNIT, CII.INPUT_TYPE = TEMP.INPUT_TYPE, CII.OPEN_PRICE = TEMP.OPEN_PRICE, CII.CLOSE_PRICE = TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, CII.HIGH_PRICE = TEMP.HIGH_PRICE, CII.LOW_PRICE = TEMP.LOW_PRICE, CII.MID_PRICE = TEMP.MID_PRICE, CII.MARKET_TYPE = TEMP.MARKET_TYPE, CII.DEAD_LINE = TEMP.DEAD_LINE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EXCHARGE_CODE,TRADE_DATE,DATASOURCE_TYPE,OPEN_PRICE,CLOSE_PRICE,HIGH_PRICE,LOW_PRICE,MID_PRICE ,BASIS_CYY,QUOT_CYY,QUOT_UNIT,INPUT_TYPE,MARKET_TYPE,DEAD_LINE,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) values( TEMP.EXCHARGE_CODE,TEMP.TRADE_DATE,TEMP.DATASOURCE_TYPE,TEMP.OPEN_PRICE,TEMP.CLOSE_PRICE, TEMP.HIGH_PRICE,TEMP.LOW_PRICE,TEMP.MID_PRICE,TEMP.BASIS_CYY,TEMP.QUOT_CYY,TEMP.QUOT_UNIT, TEMP.INPUT_TYPE,TEMP.MARKET_TYPE,TEMP.DEAD_LINE,TEMP.CREATE_USER,TEMP.CREATE_TIME,TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TEMP.UPDATE_TIME,TEMP.CREATE_DEPT )
